cards.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_expediteur_organization_id ON expediteur (organization_id);
verification_queries: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = 'expediteur' AND indexname = 'idx_expediteur_organization_id';
